samples.question: The four panels are woven into one uninterrupted navy loom; if its central weave is broken, the pattern is unreadable. Read each row of the gold-framed 5-by-6 source from left to right and count how many times neighboring squares change between cyan and cream. In the result, each row becomes one bottom-up cyan column whose height is that row's change count. Which red, green, or blue frame marks the exact five-column result?
